name: @amaral.codes/content-contract
description: Technology-free public content contract for amaral.codes

scripts.lint: npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:typecheck
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run quality:crap
scripts.quality:crap: npm run quality:crap:analyze && npm run quality:crap:assert
scripts.quality:crap:analyze: crap-typescript --package-manager npm --test-runner vitest --threshold 6 --format json --output coverage/crap.json src
